name: Spark
description: An imprint of aether from the Blind Eternities on a soul that lets a Planeswalker traverse it in relative safety.

description_citations.text: "Planeswalker (lore)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn pulls out Nissa's and Ajani's sparks and gives up Venser's spark to filter them while Melira cleans them.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 10: The Rhythms of Life

timeline.summary: After March of the Machine most of the Multiverse's planeswalkers lose their sparks and are desparked.
timeline.quote: most of the Multiverse's Planeswalkers have been desparked and are now depicted on legendary creature cards
